How we work

Commercial & technical, under one roof

You work directly with senior principals, not junior analysts, delivering technical and commercial advisory that supports the decarbonization of power generation and hard-to-abate industrial sectors across the full project lifecycle.

Commercial & strategic advisory

Full project lifecycle, from framing through financial close.

Project execution

Framing, governance and stakeholder management · risk registers · commercial negotiations · procurement · corporate, commercial and JV structuring · legal & regulatory framework review.

Strategic advisory

Decarbonisation strategy · ongoing board advisory on ESG and sustainability · investment due diligence · value-chain analysis and optimisation · debt financing advisory.

Investment advisory

Independent investment due diligence · risk mapping · commercial-structuring review · project bankability assessment for investors and lenders.

Technical & subsurface

Independent, defensible technical work behind every recommendation.

Analytical site selection

GIS multi-objective ranking of subsurface, infrastructure, land-use and permitting criteria into a defensible shortlist.

Environmental permitting

State, federal and local permitting handled together — air (PSD/NSR, Title V), water (NPDES) and site permits kept on the critical path.

Carbon capture technology selection

Independent techno-economic screening across post-combustion, pre-combustion and oxy-fuel pathways, benchmarked on real operating experience, not vendor claims.

Storage due diligence & Class VI

Subsurface and commercial due diligence, greenfield storage scoping and Class VI permit preparation, from seal integrity to MRV under 40 CFR Part 98 Subpart RR.

CO₂ transport & chain of custody

Route optimisation across pipeline, rail, truck and marine, with MRV and chain-of-custody frameworks that keep volumes tracked, verified and defensible.

Power & large-load advisory

Generation, interconnection and large-load strategy — PPAs, co-location and behind-the-meter structures.

Decision quality support

Structured decision framing, strategy generation and probabilistic economics that stand up to board and investment scrutiny.

Government liaison & stakeholder management

Direct engagement with regulators, agencies and local authorities, alongside landowners, communities and project partners, keeping approvals on track and every stakeholder informed and aligned through the project lifecycle.

Sectors

Where we work

Across power generation and the hard-to-abate industrial sectors, helping developers build decarbonization projects that are viable, bankable and built to last.

Carbon Capture, Usage & Storage

The core decarbonization pathway for power and hard-to-abate industry, from business case and feasibility through commercial structuring and execution.

Renewable Energy & Storage

Solar, wind and storage development that displaces high-carbon generation, with offtake structuring and financing.

Hydrogen

Blue and green hydrogen for hard-to-abate industry and power, with structuring and regulatory navigation.

Integrated Energy Systems

Multiple energy vectors combined into coherent, financeable decarbonization structures.

Power & Large Load

Generation and large-load growth aligned with decarbonization goals, interconnection and PPA strategy.

Ethanol & Renewable Fuels

Decarbonizing hard-to-abate transport fuels: ethanol, sustainable aviation fuel (SAF) and renewable methanol project development and structuring.

Why work with us

End-to-end capability

One accountable team, pairing deep subsurface and storage expertise with senior commercial, advisory and project-execution experience.

Technical & subsurface

Independent capture, transport and permanent-storage advisory covering site selection, Class VI permitting, MRV and decision support, grounded in decades of major capital-project delivery.

Commercial, advisory & execution

Senior commercial structuring, governance, stakeholder management and hands-on project execution across CCS, hydrogen, renewables, power and integrated energy systems, from concept through to financial close.

Partnerships

For engagements that call for additional bench strength, Carbon Stewards works alongside select specialist partners, including Low Carbon Consultants Ltd.
